description: This file defines an abstract class 'Coordinate' in the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing utility methods to manipulate and parse Excel cell coordinates and ranges, including conversions between string and numeric representations, handling absolute references, parsing ranges, and extracting cell references.

classes.name: Coordinate
classes.description: Provides static helper methods for manipulating Excel cell coordinates and ranges, including parsing, conversions, and range calculations.

methods.name: coordinateFromString
methods.description: Converts a cell address string like 'A1' into its column and row components.

methods.name: indexesFromString
methods.description: Converts a cell coordinate string into numeric column and row indexes along with the column string, handling absolute references.

methods.name: coordinateIsRange
methods.description: Detects if a cell address string represents a cell range (e.g., 'A1:A10').

methods.name: absoluteReference
methods.description: Returns an absolute reference string for a cell or range, handling worksheet names.

methods.name: absoluteCoordinate
methods.description: Returns an absolute coordinate string for a given cell address, handling worksheet names.

methods.name: splitRange
methods.description: Splits a range string into individual cell or cell range components.

methods.name: buildRange
methods.description: Builds a range string from an array of coordinate pairs.

methods.name: rangeBoundaries
methods.description: Calculates the start and end cell positions of a range.

methods.name: rangeDimension
methods.description: Calculates the width and height of a range.

methods.name: getRangeBoundaries
methods.description: Returns the range boundaries as coordinate strings.

methods.name: columnIndexFromString
methods.description: Converts a column letter (e.g., 'A') to its numeric index.

methods.name: stringFromColumnIndex
methods.description: Converts a numeric column index to its letter representation.

methods.name: extractAllCellReferencesInRange
methods.description: Extracts all individual cell references contained within a range or multiple ranges, considering sheet names.

methods.name: mergeRangesInCollection
methods.description: Merges adjacent cells with the same value into ranges.
